'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Ben Brummett DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ben Brummett]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Destroyer droid invasion
* '''Username:''' Ben Brummett
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
